translations.web: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
translations.bsb: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
translations.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
translations.asv: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.
